note: Machine-readable index of the committed prophecy datasets. Slugs are IDENTIFIERS — claims-draft-v1.json references its lists by these exact strings, so changing one orphans every mapping that points at it. claimedCount is the total the SOURCE advertises (null when it states none); the actual entry count is whatever its .json contains, and the two differing is a finding, not an error to fix. Consumed by lib/prophecy/bootstrap.ts.
